description: Every durable capture at Pi v1.2.0, made by tools/DurableFixtures/capture-all.mjs. The v1.1.0 set stays in tests/PiSharp.Durable.Tests/Fixtures (*.upstream.json(l), upstream-sessions), which the C# suites still read; each work-list area moves its suites to this set when it lands (index.json). Regenerate with the command below, never edit by hand.
command: node --no-warnings tools/DurableFixtures/capture-all.mjs <pi checkout at the commit> --commit 06a466935536f8c9bcacb2d5efc0fc021be1bdff --check

commands.examples-19-json-events.upstream.jsonl: cd <pi checkout>/packages/durable && node --conditions=source --experimental-strip-types test/examples/19-json.ts --events > <out>/examples-19-json-events.upstream.jsonl (no OPENAI_API_KEY; the temporary SQLite file it names on stderr is removed)
commands.examples-19-json-ops.upstream.jsonl: cd <pi checkout>/packages/durable && node --conditions=source --experimental-strip-types test/examples/19-json.ts --ops > <out>/examples-19-json-ops.upstream.jsonl (no OPENAI_API_KEY; the temporary SQLite file it names on stderr is removed)

varies.why: pi-ai uuidv7() on first use: random bits and Date.now(); upstream takes no seed

varies.field: SQLite page layout and file bytes
varies.why: SQLite; the records, not the pages, are the evidence

varies.field: durationMs anywhere: nested call results (pi.tool.nested documents, observed results, tool events)
the seconds in "Wall time <seconds> seconds" of codemode results
varies.why: the script's wall time, measured by upstream

varies.field: seed, startedAt and deadline of pi.codemode.run's start, and `at` of pi.codemode.journal entries
varies.why: code mode's own VM clock (Date.now()) and seed (crypto.getRandomValues), which it journals so a replay sees the same ones

varies.field: example 19: timestamps, durationMs, the faux API name ("faux:<time>:<random>") and the streamed partial messages
varies.why: the example uses the wall clock and a faux model streaming at 200 tokens per second, committed every 100 ms; ExamplesCases.cs compares them as placeholders

normalized: replace every sessionId string with "<session>", every durationMs number with "<duration>", the seconds of "Wall time <seconds> seconds" with "<seconds>", and code mode's clock and seed fields as listed, on both sides; nothing else (normalize() in tools/DurableFixtures/compare-captures.mjs)

determinism.method: capture-all.mjs --check: a second capture compared file by file with compare-captures.mjs normalization (session.sqlite files through their records); example 19 also without its streamed partial messages and with times, durations and the faux API name as placeholders
